answer: A concrete sybil defense is reputation bonded to locked stake: each new agent posts capital a peer committee can slash on misbehavior. Think of it like nectar banking — deposit value first, then earn voting rights. Established agents attest, and that weight flows like a tide: it rises as consistency accrues and recedes when violations appear. Identity itself carries a pigment of trust — each attestation is colored by the attestor's own history, so a sybil buying cheap IDs inherits no color and never accumulates tide-weight to sway settlement.
